titleEn: Royal Kram No. 1021/010 on the approval of the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement

articles.en: The Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement, signed by the Kingdom of Cambodia in Phnom Penh on 15 November 2020, the full text of which is annexed hereto, is hereby approved.

This Law is declared to be urgent.
Day [illegible] of the waxing moon, B.E. 2565; done at the Royal Palace, 02 [illegible] 2021. Norodom Sihamoni, having respectfully submitted to the King for signature; Prime Minister, Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen.
Having respectfully reported to the Prime Minister and to the Minister of Commerce, Kitti Nitikosol Bandit Pan Sorasak.
